facts.subject: items:*
facts.assertion: Every item's Motir parent is the fixture parentId, translated through the fixture-id to Plane work-item UUID map the loader records.
facts.reason: planeConnector.mapItem reads raw.parent into parentExternalId; the importer resolves it in a second pass.

facts.subject: F-41

facts.reason: raw.parent is empty, so parentExternalId is null.

facts.assertion: Every item arrives with exactly one 'kind:<kind>' label in labels, naming its fixture kind; the kind is derived from it.
facts.reason: planeConnector.mapItem reads label_details[].name; the loader writes the kind: label (translation table, kind rows).

facts.subject: subtask
facts.assertion: The native issue type is not available: type arrives null for every item, and kind (epic, story, task, bug, subtask) is label-derived.
facts.reason: planeConnector.mapItem returns type: null and discoverFields returns types: [] — the vendor has no native issue type.

facts.reason: planeConnector.mapItem reads only the state name (state.name / state_detail.name).

facts.subject: items:*
facts.assertion: Each item's resulting Motir status category equals the fixture statusCategory (status_todo, status_in_progress, status_done; status_cancelled lands in the done category).
facts.reason: The status CATEGORY is derived by the mapping resolver from the state name, not read by the connector (docs/decisions/issue-importer.md §2); this is the proof's assertion about Motir.

facts.subject: status_done
facts.assertion: Every done item arrives with a non-null closedAt later than its createdAt.
facts.reason: planeConnector.mapItem reads completed_at.

facts.subject: F-28
facts.assertion: The cancelled item's closedAt does not arrive (null).
facts.reason: planeConnector.mapItem sets closedAt: raw.completed_at ?? null; Plane stamps no completed_at on a cancelled work item and no cancelled timestamp is read.

facts.subject: F-40
facts.assertion: The cancelled item's closedAt does not arrive (null).
facts.reason: planeConnector.mapItem sets closedAt: raw.completed_at ?? null; Plane stamps no completed_at on a cancelled work item and no cancelled timestamp is read.

facts.subject: closed_at
facts.assertion: Arriving closedAt values equal the fixture's closedAt values.
facts.reason: The vendor stamps completed_at at the time of the loader's transition, not the fixture's date; the fact checked is that the value is non-null and ordered, not equal.

facts.subject: items:*
facts.assertion: Every item arrives with a non-null createdAt, and a parent's createdAt is earlier than its children's (the loader creates parents first).
facts.reason: planeConnector.mapItem reads created_at.

facts.subject: created_at

facts.reason: The vendor stamps created_at at load time; the connector reads it, but it is not the fixture value.
